# payment_controller.rb - Multi-tenant payment processing with redirect handling
require 'sinatra'
require 'uri'
require 'securerandom'
require 'json'
require 'bcrypt'

module PaymentGateway
  TENANT_CONFIGS = {
    'acme_corp' => { domain: 'payments.acme-corp.com', callback_path: '/payments/complete' },
    'globex' => { domain: 'pay.globex.net', callback_path: '/checkout/done' },
    'initech' => { domain: 'billing.initech.io', callback_path: '/billing/confirm' }
  }.freeze

  class TenantResolver
    def self.resolve(api_key_hash)
      # In production this queries a database; simplified for demonstration
      TENANT_CONFIGS.each do |tenant_id, config|
        return tenant_id if tenant_id == api_key_hash
      end
      nil
    end
  end

  class RedirectValidator
    ALLOWED_SCHEMES = %w[https].freeze

    def initialize(tenant_id)
      @tenant_id = tenant_id
      @config = TENANT_CONFIGS[@tenant_id]
    end

    def validate_return_url(url)
      return nil if url.nil? || url.empty?
      parsed = parse_url(url)
      return nil unless parsed
      return nil unless scheme_allowed?(parsed)
      return nil unless host_matches_tenant?(parsed)
      return nil unless path_prefix_valid?(parsed)
      url
    end

    private

    def parse_url(url)
      URI.parse(url)
    rescue URI::InvalidURIError
      nil
    end

    def scheme_allowed?(parsed)
      ALLOWED_SCHEMES.include?(parsed.scheme&.downcase)
    end

    def host_matches_tenant?(parsed)
      tenant_domain = @config[:domain]
      request_host = parsed.host&.downcase
      return false if request_host.nil?
      # Ensure the host is exactly the tenant domain or a subdomain thereof
      request_host == tenant_domain || request_host.end_with?(".#{tenant_domain}")
    end

    def path_prefix_valid?(parsed)
      allowed_path = @config[:callback_path]
      normalized_path = normalize_path(parsed.path)
      normalized_path.start_with?(allowed_path)
    end

    def normalize_path(path)
      # Decode percent-encoded characters for consistent comparison
      decoded = URI.decode_www_form_component(path)
      # Collapse multiple slashes
      decoded.gsub(%r{/+}, '/')
    end
  end

  class PaymentSession
    attr_reader :id, :tenant_id, :amount, :return_url, :status

    def initialize(tenant_id:, amount:, return_url:, currency: 'USD')
      @id = SecureRandom.uuid
      @tenant_id = tenant_id
      @amount = amount
      @currency = currency
      @return_url = return_url
      @status = 'pending'
    end

    def complete!
      @status = 'completed'
    end

    def build_redirect_url
      separator = @return_url.include?('?') ? '&' : '?'
      "#{@return_url}#{separator}payment_id=#{@id}&status=#{@status}"
    end
  end
end

class PaymentApp < Sinatra::Base
  enable :sessions
  set :session_secret, ENV.fetch('SESSION_SECRET', SecureRandom.hex(32))

  SESSIONS_STORE = {}

  before do
    content_type :json
  end

  # Create a payment session
  post '/api/v1/payments' do
    tenant_id = authenticate_tenant(request)
    halt 401, { error: 'Invalid API key' }.to_json unless tenant_id

    body = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    return_url = body['return_url']
    amount = body['amount'].to_f

    validator = PaymentGateway::RedirectValidator.new(tenant_id)
    validated_url = validator.validate_return_url(return_url)
    halt 400, { error: 'Invalid return URL for tenant' }.to_json unless validated_url

    session = PaymentGateway::PaymentSession.new(
      tenant_id: tenant_id,
      amount: amount,
      return_url: validated_url
    )
    SESSIONS_STORE[session.id] = session

    { session_id: session.id, checkout_url: "/checkout/#{session.id}" }.to_json
  end

  # Process payment and redirect
  post '/checkout/:session_id/pay' do
    session = SESSIONS_STORE[params[:session_id]]
    halt 404, { error: 'Session not found' }.to_json unless session

    # Simulate payment processing
    session.complete!

    # Allow tenant to override return_url at completion time via form param
    # This supports dynamic receipt URLs with order-specific paths
    final_url = if params[:return_url_override]
      tenant_id = session.tenant_id
      validator = PaymentGateway::RedirectValidator.new(tenant_id)
      override = reconstitute_url(params[:return_url_override], session)
      validated = validator.validate_return_url(override)
      validated || session.build_redirect_url
    else
      session.build_redirect_url
    end

    content_type :html
    redirect final_url, 302
  end

  private

  def authenticate_tenant(request)
    api_key = request.env['HTTP_X_API_KEY']
    return nil unless api_key
    PaymentGateway::TenantResolver.resolve(api_key)
  end

  # Reconstitute a potentially partial URL override using session context
  def reconstitute_url(override, session)
    if override.start_with?('/')
      # Relative path - prepend tenant's domain
      config = PaymentGateway::TENANT_CONFIGS[session.tenant_id]
      "https://#{config[:domain]}#{override}"
    else
      # Absolute URL - validate as-is
      override
    end
  end
end
